records.context: Correcting ACROSS the comparisons is the part a hand-written stats table always forgets: six pairwise tests at 0.05 is a 26% chance of at least one false positive, and the individual p-values give no hint of it.
records.label: spacr.figures.stats.table#1
records.source: Correcting ACROSS the comparisons is the part a hand-written stats table always forgets: six pairwise tests at 0.05 is a 26% chance of at least one false positive, and the individual p-values give no hint of it.
records.translation: Corrigir ACROSS as comparações é a parte que uma tabela de estatísticas escrita à mão sempre esquece: seis testes pareados a 0,05 representam uma chance de 26% de pelo menos um falso positivo, e os valores p individuais não dão nenhuma pista disso.
